blocker: Every charter-listed gate is green, but `npx jest src/lib/multiplayer/server` fails 33 tests in 4 suites outside the ownership path (src/lib/multiplayer/server/history/__tests__): each pins `backfillGenesisBranches()` to 1 right after a first journal append, and U19 makes that 0 by design (charter test (d)). The PR cannot pass the full required check set without a 1 -> 0 pin change on 4 lines in those 4 files. Smallest next action: the parent either widens U19 ownership to those 4 test files (4 changed lines, stays inside the caps) or lands the pin change in its owning unit first. Proven cause: with the install skipped (M1) GmCombatRewindPreview.test.ts passes 7/7.
behaviourAsImplemented: SQLiteEventHistoryBranchStore.installGenesisBranch(stream, branchId, installedAt): per-stream genesis insert on the caller transaction; root-shaped effective branch (created_by event-journal), NOT EXISTS-guarded on the stream having any branch row; effective head inserted only when the branch was, generation COALESCE(match_authority_baseline.effective_generation, 1) as the backfill reads it.

SQLiteEventJournalWriter.appendInTransaction: after the batch rows and before the head row, when there was no head for (stream, branch), installGenesisOnFirstAppend checks the branch tables exist and the stream has no journal head on any branch, then calls the store on the appended branch. Refused appends return before it; thrown appends roll it back. The sqlite_master probe moved into hasHistoryBranchTables(), reused by isSeededCandidateHead.

Five journal suites pinned backfillGenesisBranches() === 1 after a first append; they now pin 0 (the append installed it). The writer suite seed helper now asserts the backfill adds 0 and its comment says why.
